moduleDescription: Semantic analysis ("the vibecheck"). Catches the cap before Python does: undeclared reassignments, rebinding locks, mis-scoped slang, etc.

entries.name: Issue
entries.code:
Issue = object
  line*: int
  col*: int
  msg*: string

entries.name: checkProgram
entries.code:
proc checkProgram(program: seq[Stmt]): seq[Issue] {.
    raises: [KeyError, Exception], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
